Sylvie Moon: hey folks! i'm Sylvie — joining as a backend infra engineer. Originally from Montreal, now in Lisbon 🇵🇹. I knit tiny alpaca plushies, do weekend bike tours, and i'm on a gluten-free donut hunt. Quick q: is there a team lunch tomorrow? :wave:
Juno (People Ops): welcome Sylvie!! :tada: We do a new-hire lunch tomorrow at 12:30 in the SF office (virtual room for remote folks). DM me your dietary prefs. There's a channel #donut-quests for the enthusiasts 😂
Maya Chen: welcome! where in Lisbon? i'm there in june sometimes :)
Devon: hi Sylvie — i'm on infra too. welcome aboard. if you need a mechanical keyboard, ping me. also FYI the upstairs kitchen sometimes has gf donuts (they're labeled)
HR Bot: onboarding checklist: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding?newhire=sylvie — please complete: 1) 1:1 booking, 2) security training, 3) access form
Sylvie Moon: thanks all! i'm in Alfama. i'll DM Juno about lunch. anyone have recs for a tiny local yarn shop? :yarn:
Noah: welcome! there's a shop in SF called Loop & Purl (big flight though 😅). also fyi we do a casual ukulele night in the lounge on wednesdays if you're into music
Maria (EM): welcome Sylvie! i'll pair with you tomorrow morning for a product infra intro — sending calendar invite now
Juno (People Ops): added you to the new-hires offsite doc. quick snack poll for tomorrow's lunch — react with: 🥪 = Sandwiches, 🥗 = Salads (GF), 🍣 = Sushi
Sylvie Moon: reacts with 🥗
Devon: 🥪 for me but down with salad too
Maya Chen: 🍣
Juno (People Ops): also tagging @HR Bot for any remaining access issues :raised_hands:
HR Bot: flagged: badge printing queued. expect badge pickup email by EOD
Sylvie Moon: awesome, thanks everyone — excited to be here! :heart:
